summary: Mails now take you straight to the right page, and installs are easier to manage.

new.title: Mails open the right page in one click
new.text: Every mail now has the product header, one button that opens the page it is about, and a link to the web app. All mails use the same subject format.

new.title: Grant or remove engine permissions after install
new.text: A new script gives the engine a permission it is missing, or takes one away. Only the suite's own permissions can be asked for, you can preview the plan, and every change is checked.

new.title: Standard tags on the install's resource group
new.text: The install now tags its resource group with product, ring, owner, purpose and more. Tags you set yourself are kept on a re-run.

new.title: Choose your install's update ring
new.text: You can now set the update ring an install belongs to when you install it. It is reported to Invardia.
